OPL4_Mute
void OPL4_Mute()
View source

Mute OPL4 sound (FM channels output and wave channels total level) Note: A channel stays muted until OPL4_Resume is called or its register (R#C0-C8 or W#50-67) is written

OPL4_Resume
void OPL4_Resume()
View source

Resume OPL4 sound (restore registers values from before OPL4_Mute)

Channel Info
OPL4_GetChannelCount
u8 OPL4_GetChannelCount()
View source

Get the number of OPL4 channels: 18 FM channels (or 15 FM channels and 5 rhythm instruments in rhythm mode) followed by the 24 wave channels Note: OPL4_USE_CHANNEL need to be set to TRUE to use this function

Return

Number of channels (42 or 44)

OPL4_GetChannelVolume
u8 OPL4_GetChannelVolume(
u8 
chan
)
View source

Get the current volume of a given channel (FM carrier operator level or wave total level, based on the values written with OPL4_Set*Register functions) Note: OPL4_USE_CHANNEL need to be set to TRUE to use this function

Parameters
chan
u8

Channel index: part 0 FM channels 0 to 8 (in rhythm mode, 0 to 5 then bass drum, snare drum, tom-tom, top cymbal and high hat), then part 1 FM channels 0 to 8, then wave channels 0 to 23

Return

Volume from 0 (mute) to 15 (max). 0 if the channel (or rhythm instrument) is not keyed on, or if its FM outputs are disabled

OPL4_GetChannelType
u8 OPL4_GetChannelType(
u8 
chan
)
View source

Get the type of a given channel Note: OPL4_USE_CHANNEL need to be set to TRUE to use this function

Parameters
chan
u8

Channel index (same as OPL4_GetChannelVolume)

Return

CHANNEL_TYPE_SAMPLE for wave channels (last 24 channels), CHANNEL_TYPE_FM_RHYTHM for part 0 rhythm instruments (6 to 10 in rhythm mode), CHANNEL_TYPE_FM_INST otherwise

OPL4_WaveLoad
void OPL4_WaveLoad(
const 
u8* 
data,
u8 
addr_h,
u16 
addr_l,
u16 
size
)
View source

Write Wave data into the OPL4 memory Note: OPL4_USE_WAVE need to be set to TRUE to use this function

Parameters
data
const u8*

Pointer to the wave data to load

addr_h
u8

Start address in wave memory, bits 21-16 (MoonSound RAM starts at 20h, RAM-only 4 MB cartridges at 00h)

addr_l
u16

Start address in wave memory, bits 15-0

size
u16

Data size (in bytes)

OPL4_WaveGetMemSize
u8 OPL4_WaveGetMemSize()
View source

Get OPL4 total wave memory size (RAM found in the whole 4 MB wave memory space) Note: OPL4_USE_WAVE need to be set to TRUE to use this function Note: The first 2 bytes of each 128 KB block of the RAM are overwritten (on a RAM-only cartridge, this includes the header of wave 0)

Return

Number of 128 KB RAM blocks

OPL4_MEMSIZE_128K
OPL4_MEMSIZE_256K
OPL4_MEMSIZE_512K
OPL4_MEMSIZE_640K
OPL4_MEMSIZE_1M
OPL4_MEMSIZE_2M
OPL4_MEMSIZE_4M
